speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. Can you describe the specific movements you've been experiencing and when they first started? I also need to know if you have a history of psychiatric conditions or any recent changes in your medication.

speaker: Patient
text: 23-year-old college student. The patient is here for a follow-up appointment. He was recently diagnosed with schizophrenia and started on risperidone approximately 2 months ago. Reports a significant improvement in psychiatric symptoms since the start of treatment.

speaker: Doctor
text: You mentioned experiencing movement issues; can you describe exactly what those involuntary movements look like and when they typically occur? Also, have you noticed any muscle stiffness or a slowing of your movements?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Inability to remain still, persistent feeling of restlessness. I also have Frequent fidgeting, Repetitive crossing and uncrossing of legs, Pacing.

speaker: Doctor
text: These symptoms are classic for akathisia, a common side effect of risperidone. Did you experience any tremors, muscle stiffness, or sudden muscle spasms along with this restlessness?

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: Recently diagnosed with schizophrenia. No other significant past medical history. Social history: College student, lives with parents. Denies tobacco, alcohol, or drug use.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your clear presentation of akathisia induced by risperidone, I will proceed to manage this side effect. DIAGNOSIS READY: Risperidone-induced akathisia
